EmailTemplate.name: Application Suspended - Revision Inactivity
EmailTemplate.subject: Notice: Your application has been suspended (Revision overdue) - {!IndividualApplication.Name}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Application Suspended: {!IndividualApplication.Name} - {!IndividualApplication.Organization_Name__c}
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
We are writing to notify you that your grant application {!IndividualApplication.Name} for {!IndividualApplication.Organization_Name__c} has been suspended.
Reason for Suspension: Our review team previously requested revisions on your application, but no response or revised proposal was submitted within 100 days of the request.
What this means: - The revision submission window has closed and this application can no longer be edited or resubmitted. - The application status on your portal dashboard has been marked as Suspended.
If you have questions, please reach out to us at grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org.
Wadhwani Grants Platform
